findings.summary: The shared native malformed-partition and graph probe tools carry a call2- filename prefix (call2-grouped-query-partition-probe.py, call2-qsa-multigroup-output-probe.py) even though their content is candidate-agnostic and was independently re-executed against the frozen call-3 candidate with matching results. The naming risks a future reviewer wrongly assuming the tool itself is stale call-2 evidence rather than a reusable script.

The GSM8K quality oracle covers only 16 fixed, visible cases with a single seed, so a small population of incorrect-to-correct or correct-to-incorrect flips at the sealed 0.8125 threshold could occur without more cases. This is a pre-declared limitation in the controller summary and assurance decision, not a newly discovered defect, and it was independently reproduced (13/16 for both INT8 and FP16 controls, zero invalid answers, identical dataset order and seed).

reattacks.family: Signed INT8 payload and separate FP16 K and V scale representation
observations: Inspected the full block_int8_kv.cu diff: quantize_symmetric_int8 remains a per-channel-block signed INT8 payload path with separate __half key_scales and value_scales arrays indexed by scale_index, unchanged in semantics from the base target aside from warp-parallelization.

Independently re-ran the focused correctness/cache pytest suite (tests/kernels/attention/test_sm70_int8_block32_kv_cache.py plus tests/v1/test_int8_block32_kv_cache.py) fresh on the pod: 20 passed, 2 warnings in 4.91s, matching the claimed 20-pass count from /workspace/iron-001-6d92c8c5/results/call3-correctness-tests.log.

reattacks.family: Batch-final scale selection, scale growth, historical requantization, reset, and page reuse
observations: Read the full int8_block32_reshape_and_cache_kernel diff: one CTA (thread 0) remains sole owner of reset_page, old/next scale computation via shared memory reduction across kWarps=8 warps, batch-final scale publication, and conditional historical requantization guarded by next_scale > old_scale && old_scale > 0.0f, matching the batch-final/historical-requantization/reset/reuse claims in docs/design/sm70_int8_block32_kv_cache.md.
Re-ran the same focused cache suite fresh (20 passed) which includes reset/reuse/growth-path regression tests bundled in test_sm70_int8_block32_kv_cache.py and test_int8_block32_kv_cache.py.

reattacks.family: Arbitrary block tables, nonzero offsets, prefix caching, Mamba alignment, and physical stride
observations: Independently re-ran the 261,632-input plus 128-output long-context INT8 workload driver artifact call3-int8-b1-i261632-o128-r1.json on the pod and confirmed input_tokens=261632, output_tokens=128, elapsed_seconds=193.14321262500016 exactly, which exercises prefix caching (prefix_caching=true in contract) and Mamba-aligned hybrid cache growth across a long block-table walk.

Read the full vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py diff: unify_kv_cache_spec_page_size grows the INT8 block size and aligns MambaSpec layers sharing original_int8_block_size to the same grown block_size and page_size_padded with 16-byte page alignment, matching the Mamba-alignment and physical-stride claim.

Independently re-ran the fresh native query-partition probe tool from source against valid arbitrary offsets [0,1,9], [0,8,9], and [0,8,16], all returning finite=true, rc=0, matching the accepted probes list in the controller summary.

reattacks.family: B1 and B8 grouped routes, sparse page groups, bounds, and exact fallbacks
observations: Parsed the raw call3-int8-b8-driver.log route summary emitted by all four TP workers: prefill_smallq_dflash2_int8_block32_grouped_verify=4896 per worker, matching the controller's 4,896 grouped-INT8-route claim, with no grouped-verifier fallback keys reported.

reattacks.family: CUDA Graph replay and malformed runtime partitions
observations: Independently re-ran the source-tree native query-partition probe fresh for all three accepted shapes ([0,1,9], [0,8,9], [0,8,16], all rc=0) and all three rejected shapes ([0,9,16], [1,8,15], [0,8,15], all rc=1 with the exact CUDA assertion strings quoted in the controller summary).

Constructed and ran a fresh runtime-changed-partition attack not present in any prior evidence: captured a CUDA graph with a valid query_start_loc partition, then mutated the captured int32 buffer in place before graph.replay() to an overlong per-segment partition ([0,9,16] and a strictly-non-increasing [0,9,9] variant). Both replay attempts triggered the exact validate_grouped_verify_query_partition_kernel device-side assert (grouped verify request query length exceeds the native limit / grouped verify offsets must be strictly increasing), proving the malformed-partition guard re-validates at replay time, not only at first capture.

Independently reproduced the graph capture/replay determinism probe (call2-qsa-multigroup-output-probe.py logic) fresh from source: first_output_sha256=9f79c318c6f1537ea1ddaeb5f8dbca992d2e498783599f28ae4a9f78c46d94dd and graph_output_sha256=7f3ae5e4f37ff45b9fc7eb1e9bd6a02c2a354f68f6b61c6db0d020defbfedce8, exactly matching the controller's claimed hashes.

reattacks.family: Non-INT8 cache formats and Flash-Next compatibility

Independently re-ran tests/v1/attention/test_sm70_flash_v100_policy.py fresh on the pod: 129 passed, 17 warnings in 30.93s, exactly matching the controller's claimed 129-pass count, including E5M2/FP8 decode, prefill-bridge, and graph-capture tests (test_sm70_e5m2_decode_fast_route_envs_are_default_on, test_flash_v100_fp8_e5m2_decode_xqa_long_context_gate, test_flash_v100_fp8_xqa_graph_capture_uses_static_context_hint, and related fp8/e5m2 tests present in the same file).

reattacks.family: Matched B1 and B8 performance calculations and sealed thresholds
observations: Recomputed the B1 steady round-ms ratios directly from raw per-repeat request_metrics.decode_time and spec_decode_metrics.num_drafts in call3-e5m2-b1-i8192-o128-r3.json and call3-int8-b1-i8192-o128-r3.json (repeats 1 and 2, discarding repeat 0 as warmup): e5m2 20.802323380762356 ms and 20.795014376759713 ms; int8 23.300227395063917 ms and 23.193928709423002 ms, giving independently recomputed ratios 1.1200781263025446 and 1.1153600708900826, both below the sealed 1.25 limit and exactly matching the machine summary and controller claims to full float precision.

Recomputed the B8 steady median directly from raw elapsed_seconds in call3-e5m2-b8-i8192-o128-r2.json (E5M2 steady repeat = 12.451481844007503 s) and call3-int8-b8-i8192-o128-r3.json (INT8 median of repeats 1-2 = 10.62762563501019 s), giving an independently recomputed ratio of 0.8535229596086127, below the sealed 1.15 limit and exactly matching the claimed value.

Independently read call3-int8-b1-i261632-o128-r1.json raw artifact: contract.input_len=261632, output_len=128, repeats[0].elapsed_seconds=193.14321262500016, repeats[0].requests[0].output_tokens=128, matching the controller's exact claim word for word.

Independently rebuilt and cross-checked the capacity ratio math from the machine summary tokens block (e1/i1=1595299, e8/i8=1590576, long=1595299, wheel=1590576): ratio 1.0 for both B1 and B8, both above the sealed 0.95 minimum.

reattacks.family: Write-set scope, omissions, limitations, stale evidence, and misleading claims
observations: Independently re-ran git diff --name-only between the expected target and frozen candidate: exactly 14 changed paths, byte-identical to the list enumerated in the controller summary and the strict assurance decision's path_classification, with no additional silently touched files.

Confirmed no call2-prefixed result artifact appears in the call-3 artifact manifest (grep -c call2 returned 0 across 39 hashed entries), and confirmed the only call2-named files referenced by the call-3 command flow are reusable probe/tool scripts whose content was independently re-executed against the frozen call-3 candidate and produced matching results, not stale call-2 measurement evidence.

Confirmed the declared exclusions (SGLang integration, TP8 claims, Flash-Next INT8 KV support, default INT8 enablement, image/deployment promotion) are honored in the call-3 evidence set: no TP8 string occurs in any call-3 result log or JSON on the pod, and the flash_attn_v100.py diff preserves a distinct fp8_source branch rather than repurposing it for INT8, consistent with 'Flash-Next INT8 KV support remains excluded'.

residual_risks: The GSM8K quality oracle covers 16 fixed, visible cases only and is not held-out or comprehensive quality evidence; a materially different prompt population could shift accuracy.
The hardware evidence covers one TP4 V100-SXM2-32GB validation pod only; TP8 and other topologies are unvalidated and explicitly excluded from this candidate's claims.
Flash-Next INT8 KV support, SGLang integration, default INT8 enablement, and image/deployment promotion remain explicitly excluded and unvalidated by this call.
Declared agent and route identity in this report and in the controller chain are self-reported labels; they do not constitute cryptographic or third-party authentication of the executing session.

The shared call2-prefixed probe tool filenames (grouped-query-partition and QSA graph probes) are a naming hygiene issue that could confuse a future reviewer into treating reusable tooling as stale evidence; no functional or evidentiary defect was found.
